verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 is physical on-premises hardware that customers install, power, and administer themselves (PSU redundancy, node health monitoring, GPU cluster management via nvidia-smi/DCGM, container toolkit, BMC/Redfish/IPMI remote management)—all pointing to self-hosting as the default deployment model, corroborated by community reports of running it on-prem and even virtualizing it with custom isolation setups. missing for 10: independent third-party documentation of an end-to-end self-managed deployment lifecycle (e.g., procurement to production) beyond NVIDIA's own docs.
